name: broadbanner-post-production
description: Production+ post-production automation for BroadBanner creators. Turn a finished Substack live draft into a publication-ready review: download the transcript, correct it against the LIVE roster of who was in the room, generate the review with the show's server-sourced editorial config, and push it as an editable DRAFT into the member portal (app.broadbanner.com). The operator supplies only the Substack draft URL and the series name — everything else is derived through the BroadBanner MCP connector. Maps to the post_production_distribution add-on (Production+).
